en.cardTitle: A11Y Help VBA Excel: the 105 axe-core rules inside Excel
en.cardDesc: VBA add-in for Microsoft Excel that lets you query and insert, in Spanish, the 105 axe-core accessibility rules inside audit matrices and findings management.
en.cardAria: Read article about A11Y Help VBA Excel

articles.article13-p1: In real-world auditing, Excel remains the working tool: findings matrices, criteria traceability and evidence live in spreadsheets. A11Y Help VBA Excel brings the normative reference to where work already happens, instead of forcing a jump between documentation and the matrix.
articles.article13-p2: The add-in embeds the complete catalog of the 105 axe-core rules translated into Spanish: rule identifier, associated WCAG criteria, level, impact and failure description. Each rule can be looked up with an incremental search and inserted directly into the active cell.
articles.article13-p3: The flow is simple: the auditor writes a finding, opens the add-in panel, filters by criterion or free text and clicks insert. The matching rule is written in its normalized format, eliminating the transcription errors that were common when copying descriptions from the web or from axe reports.
articles.article13-h2-3: Why VBA and not an external app
articles.article13-p4: Because the goal was zero friction: no admin-privilege installs, no external services and no network dependencies. A .bas file imports into any corporate Excel and works even in the restricted environments typical of banking and government where many audits operate.
articles.article13-p5: Together with Test Cases A11Y (Gherkin test cases) and Pa11y Batch (bulk automation), this add-in covers the third leg of the workflow: formal findings documentation in the tool QA teams actually use.
articles.article13-p6: The project is open source at github.com/ingelectronicadj/a11y-help-VBAexcel.
